title: [review] COSE dataclass __eq__ silently changed by retained wire bstrs fields
description: Edge-review of y2a2 (pass 3), latent P4. Adding protected_bytes/payload_bytes to the dataclass field tuple means a decoded object no longer equals a field-constructed object with identical payload/IID/signature, and two valid transport encodings of the same logical token compare unequal. Affects delegation_tokens.py, capability_announcements.py, key_rotation_attestation.py, root_dio_signature.py (and local_facts.py from lquv). No live in-repo consumer (replay/dedup keys on IID, tests compare fields), so impact is future equality-based dedup/memoization. Fix: mark wire-bstr fields compare=False in field(), or document the equality contract on the classes.
